units: <cite ref="Shabbat 110a:4">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דתיחלא</he> a basin filled with cress.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31a:10">Ab. Zar. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ אפומא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דפ׳</he>) a basin-like vessel placed over the opening of the cask.
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a:8">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>בא׳ דמיא</he> in a bath tub.—Pl. <he>אַגָּנִין</he>, <cite ref="C01132"><he>אַגָּנֵי</he></cite>, <he>אֲנָ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 65:11">Targ. Is. LXV, 11</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 30b:11">Pes. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דמחוזא</he> the kneading basins of Mâḥuza.—<he>מֵישַׁר אֲגָנַיָיא</he> pr. n. pl.
Targ. Jud. IV, 11; Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ bot. אגנייא דקדש, later name of בצענים pools of Kadesh. [B. Kam. 61ᵇ אגני דארעא Ms. R., ponds of the field, v. בָּאגָנָא a. נָאגָנָא.]
